requests.request.to-order.brief: Turn a request into a shop order
requests.request.to-order.description: Create the production order for an accepted manufacturing request. The order carries the requestId, the request moves to in_production and the step lands in the journal. Quantity, material, deadline and contact are read off the request unless given here. Running it twice opens the order that already exists. Needs a request in context.
